title: Blood oxygen saturation
text: Warm the hand, remove nail polish, keep the finger still in the probe until the reading is steady. Record the steady value, not a flickering one.
92 to 93 percent scores watch and 91 or below scores critical under NEWS2 scale 1 (Royal College of Physicians, 2017). A low reading with symptoms is urgent: tell the crew medical officer at once.

citations.source: NEWS2 scale 1 (Royal College of Physicians, 2017): single-parameter scores for SpO2.
